AccessLevel.description:
Access level for pages, handlers, and CRUD operations.
- `'public'`: anyone can access
- `'authenticated'`: any logged-in user
- `'role:${string}'`: user must have the specified role (or a role that inherits it)
- `'owner'`: only the record owner (valid only in crudPolicy)
- `'none'`: permanently blocked (valid only in crudPolicy)

AnimationPreset.description: Animation preset types that map to Framer Motion variants. These match the existing TransitionType pattern from transitions.ts.

AnimationProps.description: Base animation configuration for any component. Can be applied to individual components via the `animation` prop.

delay.description: Delay before animation starts in milliseconds.

enter.description: The enter animation preset to use.

exit.description: The exit animation preset to use. If not specified, uses the reverse of enter animation.

layout.description:
Animate layout changes (position, size). Set to true for smooth filtering/reordering animations.
- true: animate both position and size
- 'position': only animate position changes
- 'size': only animate size changes

once.description: Only animate once when scrolling into view. Only applies when whileInView is true.

respectReducedMotion.description: Respect user's reduced motion preference. When true, animations are disabled if user prefers reduced motion.

whileInView.description: Trigger animation when element enters viewport. Useful for scroll-triggered animations.

AppTypeOption.description: app type options for web applications

AuthProviderProps.description: Configures a single authentication provider for per-app user auth (Mode B).

BackendProps.description:
Backend configuration is a discriminated union on `mode`:
- "static"  → Self-contained JSON artifact. No server, no D1, no Workers.
- "dynamic" → Deployed application with full infrastructure (D1, Workers, etc.)
- "none"    → Explicitly no backend. Frontend-only app.

ButtonDefaultProps.description: Subset of ButtonProps.variant — excludes 'destructive' and 'link' which are semantic/contextual and should not be set as global defaults.

CacheModelProps.description: Configures offline caching behavior for a specific backend model.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to store in the local cache for this model.

model.description: The backend model name to cache (must match a name in backend.models).

ownerOnly.description: If true, only the current user's records (matching owner_id) are cached.

strategy.description: The caching strategy: 'cache-first' (fast, may be stale), 'network-first' (fresh, slower), or 'stale-while-revalidate'.

CachingProps.description: Configures Service Worker caching behavior for static assets and API responses.

apiResponses.description: If true, API responses are cached for offline access.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds that cached API responses are valid.

precacheRoutes.description: List of route paths to precache during Service Worker installation (e.g., ['/', '/dashboard']).

staticAssets.description: If true, static assets (JS, CSS, images) are cached by the Service Worker.

ChartPaletteProps.description: Defines up to five series colors for charts and data visualizations, using HEX format (e.g., '#3b82f6').

chart-1.description: Color for the first data series in charts.

chart-2.description: Color for the second data series in charts.

chart-3.description: Color for the third data series in charts.

chart-4.description: Color for the fourth data series in charts.

chart-5.description: Color for the fifth data series in charts.

CodeComponentProps.description:
Code component props Now strictly structural. Content is "baked in" to the compiled module.

Can be used in two ways: 1. Direct URL: { compiled_module_url: "https://..." } 2. Repo reference: { component: "StatsWidget" } - resolves from repo.components

animation.description: Optional animation configuration for enter/exit and layout animations.

classes.description: Tailwind CSS utility classes applied to this component's wrapper element (e.g., 'p-4 bg-muted rounded-lg').

code_component_source.description: * Source code details (Optional). Used only for debugging or "Click to Edit" features in the platform.

compiled_module_url.description: * The absolute URL to the compiled ES module (for external components).

component.description: * Reference to a component in repo.frontend.components. When provided, the URL is resolved from the app's repo.frontend.components configuration.

componentType.description: The component type discriminator matching the interface name (e.g., 'CodeComponentProps'), used by DynamicRenderer to resolve the React component.

extensions.description: * Extensions required by this component (e.g., ["d3", "dnd-kit"]). Auto-detected from

inlineStyle.description: Inline CSS styles applied to this component's wrapper element. Use as a last resort — prefer typed props and `classes` for standard styling. Named `inlineStyle` (not `style`) to avoid collision with component-specific `style` variant selectors.

lastUpdatedEpoch.description: Last updated timestamp in epoch seconds, managed by the backend.

reserved_min_height.description: * CLS guard: a reserved minimum height for this component's slot, held during async load and as a floor once mounted, so the skeleton→content swap does not shift siblings below it. Stamped by the agent at codegen for above-the-fold/large sections. Accepts a CSS length (e.g. "60svh", "640px") or a number (interpreted as px). Omitted ⇒ no reservation (existing apps render exactly as before).

showWhen.description: Conditional visibility — hides component when it evaluates to false. Accepts a boolean or a $expression string (e.g., "$isLoggedIn", "$items.length > 0").

signature.description: An internal integrity hash for change-detection, managed automatically — do not set manually.

uuid.description: A UUID v4 that uniquely identifies this component instance within the app config.

source_code_url.description: * The absolute URL to the source code.

ColorPaletteProps.description: Defines the color palette for a theme mode (light or dark). Values can be hex ('#3f3f46') or bare HSL ('222.2 47.4% 11.2%'). Hex is auto-converted to HSL at runtime by DynamicTheme.

accent.description: The accent color for hover states, highlights, and selection indicators.

accent-foreground.description: The text color rendered on accent-colored backgrounds.

border.description: The color for borders on cards, dividers, and separators.

card.description: The background color for Card components.

card-foreground.description: The text color rendered on Card backgrounds.

destructive.description: The color for destructive actions such as delete buttons and error states.

destructive-foreground.description: The text color rendered on destructive-colored backgrounds.

foreground.description: The default text color rendered on the background.

input.description: The border color specifically for form input fields.

muted.description: The muted background color for subtle UI areas such as disabled states and badges.

muted-foreground.description: The text color rendered on muted backgrounds (e.g., placeholder text, help text).

popover.description: The background color for Popover, Dropdown, and Tooltip overlays.

popover-foreground.description: The text color rendered on Popover backgrounds.

primary.description: The primary brand color used for buttons, links, and active elements.

primary-foreground.description: The text color rendered on primary-colored backgrounds.

ring.description: The focus ring color shown around focused interactive elements.

secondary.description: The secondary color used for less prominent interactive elements.

secondary-foreground.description: The text color rendered on secondary-colored backgrounds.

ColumnProps.description: Configures a single column within a data model, including its type, constraints, and default value.

defaultValue.description: The default value inserted when no value is provided, must match the column type.

enumValues.description: Closed vocabulary for text columns (status, priority, tier, category). When set, seed data must use exactly these values and UI must render every entry.

isNullable.description: If true, the column accepts NULL values.

isPrimary.description: If true, this column is the table's primary key. Only one per model.

isUnique.description: If true, a UNIQUE constraint is added to this column.

name.description: The SQL column name, must match [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]* pattern (e.g., 'first_name', 'created_at').

references.description: Foreign key reference linking this column to another model's column.

summary.description: Plain-English description of this column's purpose, used by the LLM for context.

type.description: The D1/SQLite storage type for this column.

ComponentProps.description: Base interface for all renderable UI components, providing identification, conditional visibility, and animation.

animation.description: Optional animation configuration for enter/exit and layout animations.

classes.description: Tailwind CSS utility classes applied to this component's wrapper element (e.g., 'p-4 bg-muted rounded-lg').

componentType.description: The component type discriminator matching the interface name (e.g., 'CodeComponentProps'), used by DynamicRenderer to resolve the React component.

inlineStyle.description: Inline CSS styles applied to this component's wrapper element. Use as a last resort — prefer typed props and `classes` for standard styling. Named `inlineStyle` (not `style`) to avoid collision with component-specific `style` variant selectors.

lastUpdatedEpoch.description: Last updated timestamp in epoch seconds, managed by the backend.

showWhen.description: Conditional visibility — hides component when it evaluates to false. Accepts a boolean or a $expression string (e.g., "$isLoggedIn", "$items.length > 0").

signature.description: An internal integrity hash for change-detection, managed automatically — do not set manually.

uuid.description: A UUID v4 that uniquely identifies this component instance within the app config.

CrudPolicyProps.description: Configures the required access level for each CRUD operation on a model.

create.description: Access level required to create new records.

delete.description: Access level required to delete records.

list.description: Access level required to list/query multiple records.

read.description: Access level required to read a single record by ID.

update.description: Access level required to update existing records.

CustomMethodProps.description: Defines a custom code file for backend handlers, tasks, pipelines, etc.

compiled.description: Relative path to the compiled JavaScript file (e.g., 'backend/compiled/handlers/getDashboard.js'). Generated by the compile step.

source.description: Relative path to the TypeScript source file within the app repo (e.g., 'backend/code/handlers/getDashboard.tsx').

source_hash.description: Content hash of the source file (e.g., 'sha256:d41d8cd98f00'). Optional for backward compat with pre-deploy configs.

summary.description: Plain-English description of what this method does, used by the LLM for context.

type.description: Method category for organization and routing.

DatasetSchemaProps.description: Defines the structure of a dataset, including field definitions and the primary key.

fields.description: Ordered list of field definitions describing each column in the dataset.

primaryKey.description: The field name used as the primary key for record identification.

handlers.description: Custom JavaScript handlers for complex logic

models.description: Data models with automatic CRUD endpoints

FieldDefProps.description: Defines a single field within a dataset schema, including its type and display properties.

format.description: Format string for display rendering (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DD' for dates, '$0,0.00' for currency).

label.description: Display label shown in table headers and form labels. Defaults to the titleCase of the field name.

name.description: The field name matching the key in each data record (e.g., 'email', 'created_at').

required.description: If true, the field is required when generating forms from this schema.

type.description: The data type, used for formatting and input generation.

FontProps.description: Configures a font family with its weight variant and optional remote source URL.

url.description: URL to load the font from (e.g., Google Fonts CSS URL). If omitted, the font is assumed to be locally available.

variant.description: Font weight and style variant (e.g., 'regular', 'italic', '400' for regular, '700' for bold, '400italic' for italic).

ForeignKeyRef.description: Configures a foreign key reference from one column to another model's column.

column.description: The column name in the referenced model to match against (typically 'id').

model.description: The name of the referenced model (table).

onDelete.description: The action to perform when the referenced row is deleted.

FrontendProps.description: Configures all frontend UI and client-side behavior settings for a web application.

cssUrls.description: URLs of compiled CSS files for Code Focus components. Fetched once at app init and injected into the document head.

footer.description: Component trees rendered in the global footer below every page.

headTags.description: External resources to inject into `<head>`. Used for Code Focus designs that need custom stylesheets (icon fonts, typography), scripts (Tailwind CDN), or inline config (Tailwind config). Rendered in order.

header.description: Component trees rendered in the global header above every page.

headerScrollBehavior.description: Override scroll behavior for the header. Useful when header is a CodeComponent instead of NavbarProps (which carries its own scrollBehavior).

languages.description: List of supported languages for internationalization. At least one must have isDefault set to true.

layout.description: Content width strategy: 'boxed' (centered max-width), 'wide' (larger max-width), 'narrow' (compact), or 'full-width' (edge to edge).

menuPosition.description: Primary navigation placement: 'HeaderMenuTop' for horizontal navbar, 'SidebarMenuLeft' for vertical sidebar.

metadata.description: Site-wide default metadata for SEO and social sharing, overridden per-page if set.

offline.description: Offline support configuration. Enables Service Worker, IndexedDB caching, and background sync.

pages.description: Ordered list of pages in the application, each defining a route and content tree.

sidebar.description: Component trees rendered in the global sidebar (only visible when menuPosition is 'SidebarMenuLeft').

theme.description: Theme configuration including color palettes, fonts, spacing, and border radius.

transitions.description: Global page transition animations applied when navigating between pages.

HandlerProps.description: Defines a custom backend handler function with its inputs, outputs, access control, and compiled method reference.

allowedSources.description: Names of internal data sources (from backend.sources) this handler is allowed to access.

authLevel.description: The minimum access level required to invoke this handler.

handlerType.description: Whether this handler performs reads or writes (default: 'write'). Read handlers respect the declared authLevel as-is (e.g., 'public' allows unauthenticated access). Write handlers always require authentication regardless of authLevel, to prevent empty owner_id on INSERTs (H8 guard).

inputs.description: The list of input parameters this handler accepts, validated before execution.

method.description: The name of the compiled method in repo.backend.handlers that implements this handler.

name.description: The handler name, used as the API route segment: POST /api/{appId}/{name}.

outputs.description: The list of fields returned in the handler's response object.

summary.description: Plain-English description of what this handler does, used by the LLM for context.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4) for this handler.

HeadTagProps.description: A resource to inject into the document `<head>`. Supports external stylesheets, external scripts, inline styles, and inline scripts. Used by Code Focus designs to load custom Tailwind configs, icon fonts, and typography.

src.description: URL for external resources (`<link href>` or `<script src>`).

type.description:
Tag type to render:
- 'stylesheet': renders `<link rel="stylesheet" href="src">`
- 'script': renders `<script src="src">` or inline `<script>content</script>`
- 'style': renders `<style>content</style>` (sanitized)

ImageAssetRepoProps.description: Describes a stock image asset downloaded during app generation. Agent uploads to GCS; backend copies to R2 and sets `url` at deploy time.

keywords.description: Search keywords used to find this image.

source_hash.description: Content hash of the image file (e.g., "sha256:a1b2c3d4e5f6").

url.description: Resolved serve URL (set by backend after GCS→R2 copy).

IndexProps.description: Configures a database index on one or more columns for query optimization.

columns.description: The column names included in the index, in order.

name.description: The index name, used in generated SQL CREATE INDEX statements.

unique.description: If true, the index enforces uniqueness across the column combination.

InputProps.description: Defines a single input parameter accepted by a custom handler.

name.description: The parameter name, used as the key in ctx.params.

required.description: If true, the handler will reject requests missing this parameter.

summary.description: Plain-English description of this parameter's purpose, used by the LLM for context.

type.description: The expected data type for this input, used for validation before the handler runs.

LanguageOptionProps.description: Configures a supported language for internationalization (i18n).

isDefault.description: If true, this is the app's default language. Only one language should be marked as default.

nameNative.description: Language name in its native script (e.g., 'Turkce', 'Francais').

MetadataProps.description: Defines the SEO and social sharing metadata for a page or the entire site.

description.description: The description of the page or the site.

favicon.description: Site favicon as an inline SVG string (e.g. "<svg xmlns='...' viewBox='0 0 32 32'>...</svg>") or a URL.

openGraph.description: Open Graph metadata for social sharing.

type.description: Open Graph type for social media cards. Common values: 'website' for homepages, 'article' for blog posts.

title.description: The title of the page or the site.

ModelProps.description: Defines a data model (database table) with its columns, indexes, access policies, and migration settings.

autoExpandFKs.description: Whether `sys_list` should auto-expand foreign-key columns into joined sub-objects. When `true` (default), every FK column whose name ends in `_id` and whose `references.model` exists in the app's model list gets a sibling object on each row (alias = column name minus `_id`). Set `false` to suppress for cost-sensitive or privacy-sensitive parent models.

columns.description: The columns that make up this table's schema. System columns (id, owner_id, created_at, updated_at) are added automatically.

crudPolicy.description: Per-operation authentication requirements for auto-CRUD endpoints.

expandSelect.description: When this model is auto-expanded into a parent row, only return these columns. Useful for sensitive joined models that shouldn't expose every field through joins. Omit to expose all columns. Always implicitly includes the primary key.

indexes.description: Additional database indexes for optimizing queries on this model.

migrationPolicy.description: Controls how schema migrations are handled: 'safe' (additive only), 'destructive' (allows drops), 'reset' (full rebuild).

name.description: The table name in D1, must match [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]* pattern (e.g., 'books', 'loan_records').

ownerScope.description:
Owner scoping mode (default: 'user').
- 'user': all queries filter by owner_id — each user sees only their own data
- 'shared': reads/lists return all records; writes still set owner_id for audit

softDelete.description: If true, deletes set a deleted_at timestamp instead of removing the row. Auto-adds a deleted_at column during schema generation.

summary.description: Plain-English description of this model's purpose, used by the LLM for context.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4) for this model, used for migration tracking.

OfflineProps.description: Configures Progressive Web App offline support including Service Worker, IndexedDB caching, and background sync.

cacheModels.description: Model-level caching rules for offline access to backend data.

caching.description: Service Worker caching options for static assets and API responses.

conflictResolution.description: Conflict resolution when offline changes clash with server data: 'client-wins', 'server-wins', or 'manual' (user picks).

enabled.description: If true, registers a Service Worker and enables offline capabilities.

persistState.description: List of state keys (from frontend.logic.state) to persist to IndexedDB for offline access.

syncStrategy.description: Sync strategy: 'eager' (sync immediately when online), 'lazy' (sync on next request), or 'manual' (user-triggered).

OutputProps.description: Defines a single field in a custom handler's response object.

items.description: When type is 'array', describes the item type within the array (e.g., 'string', 'json').

name.description: The field name in the handler's response object.

summary.description: Plain-English description of this output field's contents, used by the LLM for context.

type.description: The data type of this output field, used for documentation and client-side type hints.

OwnerScope.description: Controls how owner_id filtering is applied to CRUD queries

PageTransitionProps.description: Defines the transition settings for a specific page, allowing for overrides. This allows for customizing or disabling transitions for individual pages.

disabled.description: If true, transitions are disabled for this specific page, ignoring the global `enabled` setting.

easing.description: Overrides the default easing function for this page.

preferNative.description: Override to use or not use the native View Transitions API for this page.

timing.description: Overrides the default transition speed for this page.

type.description: Overrides the default transition effect for this page.

viewTransitionName.description: Override the CSS view-transition-name for this specific page.

RepoComponentProps.description: Defines a custom component code file that can be loaded dynamically via CodeComponentProps.

bundle_hash.description: Babel-shell deploy-invalidation hash. Computed by the agent as sha256(entry_source_hash + "|" + sorted_module_source_hashes). The entry's `source` path embeds this hash (instead of the bare source content hash) when `supporting_modules` is non-empty — so any module change bumps the path and the backend treats it as a fresh source needing re-bundle. Absent for entries without supporting modules (their `source` path uses the content hash directly, no bundle indirection).

compiled.description: Relative path to the compiled JavaScript file. Generated by the compile step.

source.description: Relative path to the TypeScript/TSX source file within the app repo.

source_hash.description: Content hash of the source file (e.g., 'sha256:3ea3918fb19e35af'). Set by GcsOutputService after upload.

summary.description: Plain-English description of what this component renders, used by the LLM for context.

supporting_modules.description: Babel-shell per-module: names of supporting modules this entry component imports from via ES `import { X } from "./Module"`. Each entry corresponds to a `codefocus_module:<Name>.tsx` artifact bundled into this component at deploy time (esbuild --bundle=true). Empty / absent for non-Babel-shell components and for single-file Babel-shell exports.

type.description: Component type discriminator. Used by GcsOutputService to identify code components.

RepoModuleProps.description:
Babel-shell supporting module — a TSX file imported by an entry component via cross-file ES `import { X } from "./<Name>"`. Bundled into the entry's compiled JS at deploy time (esbuild
--bundle=true). Has no `compiled` field of its own because the runtime never fetches modules directly — they exist only as bundle inputs alongside the entry.

source.description: Relative path to the TSX source file in the app repo (versioned).

source_hash.description: Content hash of the source file (e.g., 'sha256:3ea3918fb19e35af').

RepoProps.description:
Repository configuration for all custom code files used by the application.

Layout: `repo.frontend.components`, `repo.frontend.styles`, `repo.backend.handlers`

assets.description: Static assets (images, etc.) managed by the platform.

backend.description: Backend code: server-side handlers, tasks, pipelines.

handlers.description: Server-side handlers keyed by method name.

components.description: Custom components keyed by name, referenced in CodeComponentProps.

fonts.description: External font stylesheet URLs loaded at page level (Google Fonts, etc.).

modules.description: Babel-shell supporting modules keyed by name. Each entry's `source` is the versioned R2 path; the deploy-time esbuild step stages these next to the entry component and bundles them via cross-file ES `import { X } from "./<Name>"`. Modules are NOT loaded directly by the runtime (no `compiled` path) — they exist only as bundle inputs. Populated by GcsOutputService when an entry component declares `supporting_modules`.

styles.description: Compiled CSS files injected into the document head (theme, Tailwind output, etc.). Each entry has `compiled` path resolved via `basePath + /repo/ + compiled`.

tailwindConfig.description: Path to the Tailwind config file in repo (e.g., 'frontend/code/styles/tailwind.config.js').

seed.description: Seed data (CSV/JSON) — universal descriptor for both static and D1 targets.

RepoStyleProps.description: Defines a compiled CSS file for Code Focus components, injected into the document head.

compiled.description: Relative path to the compiled CSS file (e.g., 'frontend/compiled/styles/theme.css').

source.description: Relative path to the source CSS/config file (e.g., 'frontend/code/styles/theme.css').

SecretProps.description: Declares a secret value (API key, token, etc.) stored securely in KV.

name.description: The secret name, used as the KV key (e.g., 'STRIPE_API_KEY').

required.description: If true, deployment fails when this secret is missing.

summary.description: Description of what this secret is used for.

SecurityProps.description: Configures per-app authentication, session behavior, and login UX.

allowSignup.description: If true, new users can self-register.

authProviders.description: Which login methods to enable for end-users.

defaultAccess.description: Default access level for pages and handlers without an explicit `access` field.

defaultRole.description: Role assigned to new users on signup.

enabled.description: Master kill-switch for app authentication. When `false`, the runtime treats the app as fully public regardless of `authProviders`, `defaultAccess`, or per-page access settings. Toggled from the admin console's Auth Settings page.

requireUppercase.description: Require at least one uppercase letter.

redirectAfterLogin.description: Route to redirect to after successful login.

redirectAfterLogout.description: Route to redirect to after logout.

requireVerification.description: If true, users must verify their email before gaining authenticated access.

roleHierarchy.description: Role inheritance map. Each key's value lists the roles it inherits (e.g., { admin: ['editor'], editor: ['viewer'] }).

roles.description: Custom role names used by this app (e.g., ['admin', 'editor', 'viewer']).

SeedRepoProps.description: Describes a seed data file (CSV or JSON) stored in the app repo.

batch_id.description:
Per-batch identifier for `'append'` mode. Recorded on the seed entry for telemetry/debugging; the seeder does NOT use it to scope DELETE statements (see the re-deploy caveat on `mode`).

Required when `mode === 'append'`. Ignored when `mode === 'replace'`.

mode.description:
Seed application strategy.

- `'replace'` (default, unchanged behavior): DELETE all rows for the   platform seed owner_id, then INSERT this seed. Idempotent re-deploys   simply re-replace the seed batch.
- `'append'`: skip DELETE; rows land under the same platform seed   owner_id as `'replace'` so the logged-in user can still see them.   Prior seed batches (the original `'replace'` seed and any earlier   append batches) are preserved. Used by the DataIngester edit-mode   flow when the user uploads a new spreadsheet that adds to an   existing dataset.

  **Re-deploy caveat:** append mode is not idempotent — re-deploying   the same turn re-inserts the rows (duplicates). Treat each   `batch_id` as a single-use deploy token.

Absent ⇒ treated as `'replace'`.

source.description: Relative path to seed file in repo/ (e.g., 'repo/seed/contacts_a1b2c3d4e5f6.csv').

source_hash.description: Content hash of the seed file (e.g., 'sha256:a1b2c3d4e5f6').

StateSchema.description: Defines the initial state of an app as a key-value map where types are inferred from the initial values.

datasets.description: Map of dataset names to static dataset definitions. Components reference via 'dataset.' prefix.

StaticDatasetProps.description: Defines a static dataset with data embedded directly in the app config. Used by StaticBackend.data.datasets.

_meta.description: Metadata for truncated datasets that are too large to embed fully.

sourceHint.description: Description of where the full dataset can be retrieved.

totalCount.description: Total number of records in the full dataset.

truncated.description: If true, the records array does not contain all available data.

generated.description: If true, the records were AI-generated and a "sample data" banner is shown in the UI.

generationHint.description: Descriptive hint for AI data generation (e.g., 'e-commerce products with price and category').

records.description: Array of data objects, each should include a field matching the schema's primaryKey.

schema.description: Optional schema to help the LLM and components understand the data structure.

type.description: Dataset type discriminator, always 'static' for inline data.

StyleVariableProps.description: Configures global CSS custom properties for shadows and transitions.

ThemeProps.description: Defines all customizable theme properties for a WebApp.

charts.description: Color palette for chart/data-visualization series (chart-1 through chart-5).

dark.description: Color palette applied when the user is in dark mode.

defaultTheme.description: Which color mode to render by default. Omit for light.

defaults.description: Global component variant defaults. Resolution order: component prop > form-scoped override > theme.defaults > built-in default.

fontSizes.description: Defines the font size for different typographic scale steps.

fonts.description: Font configurations for body text and headings.

body.description: Font used for body text, paragraphs, and general content.

heading.description: Font used for headings (h1-h6) and display text.

layout.description: Layout dimension overrides for the main content container.

containerWidth.description: Maximum width of the content container (e.g., '1280px', '80rem').

contentPadding.description: Horizontal padding inside the content container (e.g., '1rem', '2rem').

light.description: Color palette applied when the user is in light mode.

spacing.description: Global spacing values applied to page sections.

x.description: Horizontal content padding as Tailwind spacing value (e.g., '4', '6').

y.description: Vertical section padding as Tailwind spacing value (e.g., '8', '12').

styles.description: Global CSS custom properties for shadows and transitions.

TransitionProps.description: Defines the global configuration for all page transitions in the application. This is typically set once in the main application configuration.

easing.description: The easing function to apply to the animation, controlling its acceleration curve. These correspond to standard CSS/Framer Motion easing functions.

enabled.description: Enables or disables all page transitions globally.

preferNative.description: When true, prefers the native View Transitions API when available. Falls back to Framer Motion for unsupported browsers.

respectReducedMotion.description: If true, animations will be disabled if the user has requested reduced motion in their operating system settings.

timing.description: The default speed of the transition.

type.description: The default transition effect to use for all pages. This can be overridden on a per-page basis.

viewTransitionName.description: The CSS view-transition-name for the animated element. Used for targeting specific elements with View Transitions API.

TransitionType.description: Defines the available visual effects for page navigation.

WebAppProps.description:
WebAppProps - Root configuration schema for Exepad web applications

Extends AppProps with web-specific configuration:
- frontend: All UI configuration (theme, pages, logic, etc.)
- backend: All server configuration (models, handlers, etc.)
- repo: Custom code registry (Tier 2 methods)

alias.description: The URL-friendly subdomain alias (e.g., 'my-crm-app'), used in the deployment URL: {alias}.exepad.com.

appSecondaryType.description: Application secondary type that categorizes the app by its primary purpose (e.g., 'website', 'dataapp').

appType.description: Application Type discriminator that determines which interface to use for parsing.

backend.description: Backend config. Omit for frontend-only (static) apps.

frontend.description: Frontend config. Omit for backend-only apps.

lastUpdatedEpoch.description: Last modified timestamp in epoch seconds.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the admin panel and browser tab.

repo.description: Central registry for all custom code files (Tier 2). All handlers, tasks, computed functions, actions, etc. reference methods by name.

secrets.description: Required secrets (API keys, tokens) stored in KV.

shortSummary.description: One-line summary for listings and search results.

signature.description: An internal integrity hash for change-detection, managed automatically -- do not set manually.

summary.description: Detailed description of the application's purpose and features.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4) for this application.

version.description: The semantic version of the app config (e.g., '1.0.0').

WebPageProps.description: A standard web page. This interface extends PageProps without additional properties, serving as a distinct type in the PageType discriminated union.

access.description: Access control for this page. Determines who can view it.

classes.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the page wrapper element.

content.description: The ordered list of component trees that make up the page body.

lastUpdatedEpoch.description: Last updated timestamp in epoch seconds, managed by the backend.

layout.description: Content width strategy for this page, overrides the app-level layout setting.

menuPosition.description: Override the app-level menuPosition for this page. When set, this page uses the corresponding nav shell (header or sidebar) instead of the app-level default.

metadata.description: Page-specific SEO and social sharing metadata that overrides site-wide defaults.

pageType.description: The page type discriminator that determines which page interface to use.

shortSummary.description: Short one-sentence summary of the page, visible to the user. This is not the SEO description.

signature.description: An internal integrity hash for change-detection, managed automatically -- do not set manually.

slug.description: URL path starting with '/' (e.g., '/', '/about', '/products/:id'). Dynamic segments use ':paramName' syntax.

summary.description: Comprehensive summary of the page, visible to the user. This is not the SEO description.

title.description: Human-readable page title displayed in the navigation and browser tab.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4) for this page instance.
